notes: Only XML whose SubModule.xml XmlNode includes GameType CustomGame (or no IncludedGameTypes) is loaded by CustomGame (TaleWorlds.ObjectSystem.MBObjectManager.GetMergedXmlForManaged). troops[*].loaded_in_customgame reflects this. SandBox/ModuleData/bandits.xml (looters, sea raiders, ...) is Campaign/CampaignStoryMode ONLY.

tier = BasicCharacterObject.GetBattleTier formula min(max(ceil((level-5)/5),0),7) clamped to 6 (same as DefaultCharacterStatsModel.GetTier); tree_tier = depth in upgrade tree from a root (1 = recruit).
formation = XML default_group (FormationClass, case-insensitive); formation_from_gear = derived from resolved battle equipment (horse + bow/crossbow).

Equipment resolution mirrors BasicCharacterObject.Deserialize: inline <EquipmentRoster> (civilian="true" → Civilian), <EquipmentSet id equipmentType> pulls matching-type sets from global EquipmentRosters, direct <equipment> children override every set.

item tierf: exact DefaultItemValueModel.CalculateTier for armor/horse/harness/bow/crossbow/ammo/shield; crafted weapons use the _tN id suffix (TaleWorlds naming) or average crafting-piece tier (approximation; the real formula also needs computed melee stats). tier = clamp(round(tierf),0,6).

Crafted weapon usages = template WeaponDescriptions whose AvailablePieces contain every used piece (TaleWorlds.Core.Crafting.GenerateCraftedItem). couch = TwoHandedPolearm_Couchable, brace = TwoHandedPolearm_Bracing, pike = TwoHandedPolearm_Pike.

troop_fields.line: regular | noble (elite_basic_troop tree) | militia | minor_faction (*_tier_N) | mercenary (neutral_culture) | caravan | guard | bandit (Campaign-only) | bandit_upgrade | gangster | quest (Campaign/StoryMode-only special) | legacy (obsolete_characters.xml)
troop_fields.tier: level-based troop tier 0..6 (DefaultCharacterStatsModel.GetTier); tree_tier: depth from tree root (1 = root)
troop_fields.formation: XML default_group normalised to FormationClass name; formation_from_gear: Cavalry/HorseArcher/Ranged/Infantry from resolved battle equipment
troop_fields.ranged: 'bow' | 'crossbow' | 'throwing' | 'sling' | 'none' — majority across battle variants, only if >=50% of variants carry a ranged weapon; ranged_all lists every ranged kind seen
troop_fields.mounted: true if >=50% of battle variants have a mountable Horse; mount_kind horse|camel|mule
troop_fields.shield_polearm_etc: shield / polearm / couch_lance (mounted + couchable usage) / brace_spear / pike / two_handed: >=50% of battle variants; ratios.* gives the exact share
troop_fields.armor: average over battle variants of summed head/body/arm/leg armor of all worn pieces; armor_class u<30 l<60 m<100 h<150 vh>=150
troop_fields.sample_set: first resolved battle equipment variant (slot -> item id), handy as a template for CK3Bridge custom troops
troop_fields.loaded_in_customgame: XML file is loaded for game type CustomGame (spawnable in a custom battle mission)
troop_fields.custom_battle_ui_selectable: would show in the vanilla Custom Battle troop picker (IsSoldier && !IsObsolete && CB faction)

custom_battle.evidence: TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.CustomBattle (v1.4.8): CustomBattleData.Factions/Characters, CustomBattleHelper.GetDefaultTroopOfFormationForFaction, ArmyCompositionGroupVM ctor (c.IsSoldier && !c.IsObsolete), ArmyCompositionItemVM.IsValidUnitItem (culture == selected && DefaultFormationClass match)

mapping_hints.status: INFERRED design suggestion generated by the rules below from this catalog; tune in bridge/mapping.json

levy_melee.why: CK3 levies (melee share): culture recruit/T2 foot + militia spearman

levy_ranged.why: CK3 levies (ranged share): militia archer + T2 foot ranged

pikemen.why: pike > bracing spear > any polearm infantry

crossbowmen.why: foot crossbowmen (CK3 crossbowmen/ballistrai are base type archers)

light_cavalry.why: light/medium cavalry, no couched lance preferred

knights.why: CK3 knights: top of the noble (elite_basic_troop) line

camel_cavalry.note: Native camel riders exist only in minor factions (jawwal, ghilman). For culture-accurate camel cavalry define CK3Bridge NPCCharacters reusing an Aserai/Khuzait rider kit with Horse=camel|war_camel|special_camel and HorseHarness=camel_saddle (harness family_type 2 = camel).

special.elephant_cavalry: no elephants in v1.4.8: use the culture heavy_cavalry pick (or special_camel riders) and apply a per-agent health/charge multiplier in CK3Bridge; convert counts by CK3 damage/toughness ratio
special.gunpowder: no SP firearms: use the crossbowmen pick
special.siege_weapon: not representable in a field battle mission: skip (siege engines only exist in siege missions, OpenSiegeMissionWithDeployment)

gunpowder.note: No firearms in v1.4.8 single-player items (ItemTypeEnum has Pistol/Musket/Bullets but no SP items use them). Substitute CK3 gunpowder MAA (handgunners, fire_lancers) with heavy crossbowmen.
